result.keyword: What's the best payroll software for a small business?
result.markdown:
The best payroll software for a small business depends on how many employees you have, your budget, and whether you need payroll to integrate with your accounting software.

**If you're running a small business in the UK, I'd start by comparing Xero Payroll, Sage Payroll, BrightPay and QuickBooks Payroll.** These are more relevant to UK PAYE, HMRC reporting and pension auto-enrolment than popular US-focused options such as Gusto.

Here’s how I'd narrow it down.

## Best UK payroll software compared

| Software | Best for | Indicative price |
|--------|--------|--------|
| Sage Payroll | Best standalone option | From £12/month |
| BrightPay | Comprehensive payroll features | Quote required |
| Xero Payroll | Existing Xero users | From £1.50/employee/month |
| QuickBooks Payroll | Existing QuickBooks users | From £5/month + employee fees |
| Moneysoft | Keeping costs low | Around £95/year |


Prices are indicative and generally exclude VAT. Check current pricing before subscribing. [www.workforce.com](https://www.workforce.com/uk/buyers-guides/best-payroll-software-in-the-uk-2026?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[velotouch.com](https://velotouch.com/best-payroll-software-for-uk-small-businesses/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[paydocs.co](https://paydocs.co/blog/uk-payroll-providers-compared?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendations

![Sage Payroll](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/YilOgYs9ZP1wfwRzJkFxhA_BlX-p_5FLJTmLkaXii1Zq8iZVEoUFx_wBfKoiVfr0ATGd3JsvVUZhJ3dfKZOkGYm_SBzjjNOitZcJhhfq0Ikj-wTCq4Ucb9ThPMpreJ_oVOHjuM4KTvvryzuP8dhTVsVMgw7AVYaGKaHDYZzKiFaOrf3CUXwlR8gKxA64DoWs?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Sage Payroll — best overall standalone choice**

Good for small businesses wanting PAYE calculations, HMRC submissions, payslips and pension auto-enrolment without buying a full accounting package.

[Sage Payroll website](https://www.sage.com/en-gb/products/sage-business-cloud/payroll/)

---

![BrightPay Payroll – Free Until March 2026 | FinanceBox](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/03z0i67ObfyUtqEovrIhE-QUZsjEEY5hoUxN9RNgiCyefGKSxw8BF2HAwMmXzZxYUY5r63sza07Tc3aDUu9knu5SXhXML41iLyhBeNc8R9yMSTIoElfZ2MdVjM1x1phpSmygJDRwuyWaUzK1VF8cdf0SYUsm1ZQ7mBPIV6k3miGnspSAqd6s06MuchAt47wL?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. BrightPay — best for payroll functionality**

Particularly worth considering if you have several employees, pensions, statutory payments or more complicated payroll requirements.

[BrightPay website](https://www.brightpay.co.uk/)

---

![Free High-Quality xero logo png for Creative Design](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/9qnwxOObu7ODCnjvtZS3OrO0aEo-O6ZxoDMA_BgXWHmpclDvIBWhiiFc7sv2CSwP8u7lVkQexj-2Q6JwX6bLCkmQGBaOEFUaRc4WBhsOFHNZO-ImlbOxfjscA06CBlmqvsyW9qGAz0ywS1dS_FiB_uxDnV6_EbbsbiPoLuJHAA6MH09EB8jLexW7FAqo1iFu?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Xero — best for integrated accounting**

Excellent if you already use Xero for bookkeeping. Payroll information can feed into your accounts, reducing duplicate administration.

[Xero website](https://www.xero.com/uk/)

---

![Moneysoft Payroll Manager User Reviews & Pricing For 2026 - BusinessFinancing.co.uk](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/7ksdOV7E-FuiXPxwB-8w5JZkSHtBcjkVxCJYbFrODk4PmznMHOmA4B-tBaxnYCFYD6Jp0kSAbnQXIsecvAn3rHv3L9eIJmTsQHps-CqLdeVCxq8PEavEP85m-O6tbVJZIUw1amDOLcBgiDPKuXotb0Z1X2mhBds1tgi1vwa-scPjVzxF5ozKfmnh-hP00M1w?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Moneysoft — best budget option**

A good choice for smaller employers who want capable payroll software without a large monthly subscription. Its main drawback is that it is Windows-based desktop software.

[Moneysoft website](https://moneysoft.co.uk/)

## What I'd look for before choosing

Make sure the software supports\:

- HMRC Real Time Information (RTI) submissions.
- PAYE and National Insurance calculations.
- Automatic workplace pension enrolment.
- Holiday pay and statutory sick pay.
- P45s, P60s and employee payslips.
- Easy year-end reporting.

search_results.description: The article reviews payroll platforms for small businesses in 2026, assessing features, pricing, usability, integrations, documentation, and customer support. Gusto is its top dependable choice, combining full-service payroll, tax compliance, benefits, and accounting integrations. Xero stands out for accounting and app integrations, while QuickBooks is recommended for mobile payroll. Paychex suits businesses seeking outsourced HR and benefits administration; Rippling offers flexible, scalable HR, payroll, IT, and expense tools. Remote Payroll supports international hiring and compliance, and Zoho People bundles payroll with a broad HR and business ecosystem. Other picks include PeopleHR for UK SMEs, Patriot Payroll for straightforward value, BambooHR for ease of use, Hourly for time tracking and workers’ compensation, 1st Money for small UK businesses (free for fewer than 10 employees), Breathe HR for simplified HR, and Employment Hero for advanced features. The article also highlights ADP’s payroll and HR services. It advises choosing software based on business size and required features, prioritizing compliance, integrations, transparent pricing, employee self-service, and responsive support.
